title: Push Guard
bottom_line: Run /ui-change-guard:push-guard install once per clone. From then on, every push from Claude or your terminal waits for the UI review to pass.

sections.heading: One command turns the guard on, off, or reports its state

blocks.caption: Pick one of the three words. With no word, or any other word, the skill asks which one you mean.

rows: Turns the review into a pre-push gate for the current repo: pushes Claude makes and pushes from your terminal.
Turns the gate off and removes the guard's git `pre-push` hook.
Says whether the gate is on, whether the git hook is installed, and how many reviewed commits are recorded.

blocks.title: When to use it
items: When you want to "review before every push", "add a pre-push hook" or "run the UI review automatically on push".
When you want to "turn off" or "remove the push check".
When you ask whether the guard is on.

blocks.text: It works on the git repository in the current directory and shows you what the guard printed.

sections.heading: You need Python 3, git and the claude command

cards.title: git
cards.text: The guard lives in the repo's `.git/` folder.

cards.title: claude on your PATH
cards.text: Needed for the terminal push guard, because the git hook runs the review through `claude -p`.

blocks.text: The guard is per clone. It lives in `.git/`, nothing is committed, and teammates install it themselves. The plugin has no environment variables and no plugin settings.

sections.heading: After install, both kinds of push wait for the review

blocks.title: What happens to a push after install
blocks.caption: A commit that has already passed review goes straight through on either path.

blocks.text: Right after install, the skill tells you these two things in two lines.

items: When Claude runs `git push`, the push is blocked until `/ui-change-guard:review-ui-change` passes for that commit (SAFE or NEEDS ENGINEER REVIEW).
When you push from a terminal, git runs the review through `claude -p` (takes a few minutes and uses tokens) and blocks on UNSAFE. `git push --no-verify` skips it once.

sections.heading: Claude's pushes are checked by a hook on every command it runs

blocks.title: When Claude tries to push an unreviewed commit

steps.title: The push is blocked
steps.text: The hook stops `git push` and tells Claude the review has to pass for this commit first.

steps.title: Claude runs the review
steps.text: Claude runs `/ui-change-guard:review-ui-change` and shows you the report.

steps.title: SAFE or NEEDS ENGINEER REVIEW
steps.text: Claude records the commit as reviewed and pushes again.

steps.title: UNSAFE
steps.text: Claude does not push. The blockers must be fixed first.

blocks.text: The plugin registers a `PreToolUse` hook, a small Python check that runs before each Bash command Claude runs, in every repo. It does nothing until you run `/ui-change-guard:push-guard install` in a repo. After that, it blocks `git push` there until the review passes for HEAD. In repos without the guard it stays inactive.

sections.heading: Terminal pushes run the full review, which takes minutes and tokens

nodes.label: Review runs via claude
nodes.note: A few minutes and some tokens per push.

blocks.text: `install` also writes a git `pre-push` hook that runs the full review through `claude -p` on every push from your terminal. Because that run has Bash, the review's handoff step also updates the PR body on each guarded push.

blocks.title: Skip the review for one push
Messages you may see in the terminal
rows: `ui-change-guard: reviewing UI changes before push (skip with: git push --no-verify)...`
The review has started. Its report follows.
`ui-change-guard: verdict UNSAFE, push blocked. Fix the blockers above, or skip with: git push --no-verify`
The review found Blockers. The push did not happen.
`ui-change-guard: claude CLI not found, push blocked. Skip with: git push --no-verify`
The `claude` command is not on your PATH.
`ui-change-guard: review did not run (exit <status>), push blocked. Skip with: git push --no-verify`
The review failed to run, so the push was blocked.

blocks.text: With any other verdict, the push goes ahead and the commit is recorded as reviewed.

sections.heading: Each commit is reviewed only once

before.label: First push
before.text: The commit has no record, so the review runs. If it passes, the commit is recorded in `.git/ui-change-guard/reviewed-<sha>`.

after.label: Next push
after.text: The record is there, so the push goes straight through without another review.

blocks.text: This is not configurable. It also means that if you open a PR after the commit passed, the review will not run again for that commit on its own. Re-run `/ui-change-guard:review-ui-change` by hand to write the engineer handoff into the new PR.

sections.heading: The guard prints a short status after each command

cards.title: install
cards.text: The git hook is written and the Claude Code push gate is on.

cards.title: uninstall
cards.text: The git hook is removed if it was the guard's, and the push gate is off.

cards.title: status
cards.text: Gate on or off, hook installed or not, and the count of reviewed commits.

blocks.title: After install
blocks.code:
Installed.
  git pre-push hook: <path of the pre-push hook>
  Claude Code push gate: on (state in <state folder>)

blocks.title: After uninstall
blocks.code:
Uninstalled.
  git pre-push hook: removed | none of ours found
  Claude Code push gate: off

blocks.title: After status
blocks.code:
Claude Code push gate: on | off
git pre-push hook: installed | not installed (<hook path>)
reviewed commits recorded: <n>

sections.heading: Install will not overwrite a pre-push hook you already have

cards.title: Existing pre-push hook
cards.text: Install refuses to overwrite a `pre-push` hook that is not the guard's, such as one from husky.

points.text: Add a call to `claude -p /ui-change-guard:review-ui-change` to your hook by hand.
Or remove your hook and run install again.

cards.title: Not in a git repository
cards.text: The guard prints `Not inside a git repository.`

points.text: Run it from inside the repository.

blocks.title: The message when a hook already exists
blocks.code: Not installed: <hook> already exists and is not ours. Add a call to `claude -p /ui-change-guard:review-ui-change` to it by hand, or remove it and re-run.

blocks.title: Good to know
items: When the guard reports an error, the skill shows it and stops. It never deletes or overwrites a `pre-push` hook the guard refused to touch, and leaves the decision to you.
`/ui-change-guard:push-guard uninstall` removes the guard's git hook and turns the gate off.

next_action.text: In the repository you want guarded, run `/ui-change-guard:push-guard install`.
next_action.detail: Then run `/ui-change-guard:push-guard status` any time to check the gate is on.
